scope: First funded public-testnet no-reveal refund: Zcash public testnet (Ironwood, NU7 branch 77190ad9) and Ethereum Sepolia. Nobody revealed t; Bob took his ETH back after the ETH deadline and Alice took her ZEC back after the later Zcash refund height. One host runs both owner clients; observations use trusted RPC providers. Not a consensus or finality proof, not independent hosts, not mainnet.

trade.escrow_note: The same pinned PointEscrow deployed for the 2026-10-18 success run; no new deployment.

transactions.step: F: source note to the shared note
Bob refunds the order after the ETH deadline (no claim, t never published)
A: Alice's pre-signed auxiliary transaction creates the refund coin from her own change
R: Alice's time-locked refund spends the joint note and A's coin

setup_transfer.step: Funding transfer, not part of the protocol: Bob to Alice 0.001 ETH so Alice holds her claim reserve

final_checks.eth_order: refunded and withdrawn; lock, refund and withdrawal receipts provider-finalized with their expected escrow events
final_checks.alice_claim_history: never prepared or sent; local_claim_may_be_exposed false throughout
final_checks.native_refund: R confirmed by the provider (17 confirmations at the first reconcile); its observed bytes match the staged version 2601b5627e2c282ef7f0e13c38d195e830f0705302bd9aea67b895315d0c0fc9
final_checks.alice_wallet: Alice's own native wallet decrypted the 100,000-zatoshi refund note at height 4520981

commands: python3 scripts/public_source_execute.py ALICE SOURCE CONSENTS --eth-rpc RPC --broadcast-testnet
python3 scripts/public_eth_execute.py BOB CONSENTS lock --eth-rpc RPC --broadcast-testnet
python3 scripts/public_eth_outgoing.py prepare BOB CONSENTS --action refund --eth-rpc RPC  (after the finalized block passed eth_expiry)
python3 scripts/public_eth_execute.py BOB CONSENTS refund --eth-rpc RPC --broadcast-testnet
python3 scripts/public_eth_execute.py BOB CONSENTS withdraw --eth-rpc RPC --broadcast-testnet
python3 scripts/public_auxiliary_execute.py ALICE SOURCE CONSENTS --eth-rpc RPC --broadcast-testnet
python3 scripts/public_native_execute.py ALICE 2601b5627e2c282ef7f0e13c38d195e830f0705302bd9aea67b895315d0c0fc9 CONSENTS --watch-wallet ALICE-WATCH --eth-rpc RPC --broadcast-testnet
operational_notes: The escrow deployment of 2026-10-18 was reused by copying its retained deployment record; public_deploy reported it finalized and sent nothing.
Bob's refund preparation refused until the provider-finalized block passed the ETH deadline (about 20 minutes after expiry), as the sender requires.
A first refund check created an empty action folder before any decision existed; it held no decision or signature and was removed before preparing again.
The native refund check refused twice because a new block arrived between the watch-wallet sync and the tip check; syncing immediately before the check resolved it.
The funding transfer's first send through Python urllib returned HTTP 403; the same signed bytes were resent with curl.
limits: Both owners ran on one host and OS account; not independent administration.
Trusted RPC providers (Tenderly, publicnode, testnet.zec.rocks); provider finality labels are not local consensus verification.
Public Zcash hashes do not prove the private amounts to a third party; the 100,000-zatoshi figure comes from Alice's own wallet decryption.
